rows.grounds: Nominal form ṛṣi; in mantra-ritual declarations this identifies the seer (ṛṣi) of the formula, consistent with the passage’s ritual/mantra framing.
Compound analyzed as tri-ka/tri + anuṣṭubh + ukta (‘spoken/declared’); qualifies chandaḥ as the meter, in line with mantra specification elements (ṛṣi, chandaḥ, devatā).
Nominal form chandas; denotes the metrical form in the standard mantra declaration sequence.
Sandhi-resolved form read as caṇḍa/asya or caṇḍā-asya with uncertainty; taken as indicating the deity associated with this formula, preceding devatā.
Nominal form devatā; identifies the presiding deity in the mantra declaration context.
